name: revit-mcp-cowork
description: Windows 11-only Codex plugin for safe Revit 2024 automation with evidence-driven learning from local Codex task history.

interface.shortDescription: Windows-only Revit 2024 workflows through MCP Next.
interface.longDescription: On Windows 11, inspect and automate Autodesk Revit 2024 with compact reads, guarded preview/apply writes, setup diagnostics, documentation workflows, and a review-gated improvement loop that learns from Revit-related local Codex tasks.
defaultPrompt: Set up the weekly Revit learning automation on this PC.
Check Revit and summarize the active model.
Plan this Revit change and preview it safely.
Audit the current Revit views and sheets.
